A '''Photo-reactive coating''' was a type of armor enhancement manufactured by [[Krail Armory]] for use in their [[Model 1010 Photo-reactive Personal Armor]].<ref name="Outback" />

==Characteristics==
Photo-reactive coatings were made by producing small, synthetic, photosensitive microscopic crystals that reflected and warped the ambient light and color around it.<ref name="Outback" /> When applied to armor it rendered the wearer nearly invisible, and extremely difficult to detect visually in virtually every environment.<ref name="Outback" /> This coating could then be toggled on and off at the wearer's leisure.<ref name="Outback" />

These crystals were commonly applied to the [[Model 1010 Photo-reactive Personal Armor]], where it acted as a [[Optical camouflage system/Legends|optical camouflage system]].<ref name="Outback" /> Due to the suit's camouflage abilities, however, the suit was considered illegal in most systems.<ref name="Outback" />

While photo-reactive coatings did much to prevent visual detection, they did little to shield the wearer from [[sensor]]s; this is shown by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]], who fortified her suit with sensor stopping [[Reflec/Legends|reflec]] plating, atop of which pho-reactive coating was applied.<ref name="Outback" /> Combined, Mist was considered to be virtually undetectable, be it visually or through sensors.<ref name="Outback" />
